name: hov
description: Fleet mailbox for coding agents. A per-host SQLite mailbox with FTS5 search, a stdlib-only CLI (send, inbox, thread, search, ls), hooks that deliver mail into Claude Code sessions as hook context text at the next prompt or tool call and wake a session idle at its prompt when direct mail arrives, an outbound ssh link that carries mail between hosts store-and-forward, and an MCP server plus a count-only notifier for agents without a Claude Code hook (Codex, oh-my-pi). Mail changes what a session reads, never what it may do.
